headline: Stardust Synchron Deck
title: Stardust Synchron Deck Guide | Best Yu-Gi-Oh Duel Links Decks November 2026
video_script: This is the Stardust Synchron deck in Yu-Gi-Oh Duel Links, a Tier 3 deck on Duel Links Meta this week. The Skill is Bonds of the Converging Stars. At the start of the Duel it adds five Synchro Monsters to your Extra Deck. Once per Duel it plays two Level four Stardust monsters from your Deck and adds Shining Star Dragon, and once per Duel it plays three Signer Dragons from outside your Deck. The key cards: Stardust Synchron Tributes a monster to Special Summon itself, and adds a Spell or Trap that mentions Stardust Dragon. Stardust Trail comes back from your hand or Graveyard when a monster you control is Tributed. Shining Star Dragon revives a Dragon Synchro on your opponent's turn and Synchro Summons right away. Red Reign banishes every monster on the field except the highest Level ones, when you control a Level eight or higher Synchro. And the boss, Red Supernova Dragon, a Level twelve Synchro with four thousand attack that can banish itself and every card your opponent controls. How does it play? Yusei's Synchro Dragons come out on both turns, Red Reign clears the board, and Red Supernova Dragon finishes the Duel. This list is a King of Games Cup top 100 list from the nineteenth of November, with 24 cards in the Main Deck. Which deck should I cover next? Comment below!
